Hi,

Short answer: it depends on where you are, and in most cases there is nothing extra for you to pay.

We ship from three warehouses and the one that serves your address is the one your order leaves from. Orders going to the US and the rest of the world ship from our US warehouse, Canadian orders ship from our Canadian warehouse, and orders going to Europe and the UK ship from our warehouse in Rotterdam, in the Netherlands. So a European order arrives from inside the EU, with no import VAT, duties or customs charges on delivery.

For US and Canadian addresses there are no import duties either. Sales tax, where it applies, is added at checkout along with shipping.

A couple of our products are shipped directly by the manufacturer rather than from our warehouse, and the product page says so. If you tell me which miner you are looking at and the country you want it delivered to, I will confirm exactly where it ships from before you order.

Happy to help you pick the right unit too, just tell me your budget and your power cost.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
